name: Breakout watch
description: Display-only. After a BUY, BREAK marks the first candle whose high reaches entry close +pct% within `candles` candles; NO BREAK marks the last watch candle when none did (historically ~13% of those trades won vs ~55% for BREAK). BREAK FAIL replaces BREAK when that candle closes back at or below the entry close: historically BREAK ~+$193 avg / 61% win vs BREAK FAIL ~-$74 / 27% (a caution label; selling on it lost money). A dashed watch line shows the target while the watch is open. Does not change trades, P/L, Status or Telegram.
_comment: build: false removes the watch everywhere (chart, Status Event column, Summary BRK column and what-ifs). display: false keeps Status/Summary but hides the chart markers and watch line.

line.title: Watch +{pct}%
line._comment: lineStyle: solid|dotted|dashed|largeDashed|sparseDotted. {pct} in title is replaced by settings.pct.
